homilies.title: 生命的意義是什麼？
homilies.content:
生命的意義是什麼？當我們心情低落，親友又不在身邊時，我們什麼也不想做，開始懷疑自己究竟為了什麼而活。我曾為家人、為朋友，也為自己而活，可是現在什麼也不想做。人究竟是為了什麼而活呢？

感謝天主，我們知道自己為誰而活，也知道是誰創造了我們。我們明白，今生與永生相比，實在微不足道。當我們受苦、被親友傷害，或陷入自己無法解決的困境時，我們確信，還有一位可以依靠。

耶穌，這是無可取代的名字。世上賜給人的一切名字中，唯有這個名字能使我們得救。感謝天主揀選我們成為祂的子女。但如果我們不宣講福音，也不在生活中實踐福音，別人怎麼會知道耶穌一直在幫助我們呢？

正如聖保祿所說：人若不信祂，怎能呼求祂呢？若沒有聽過祂，怎能相信祂呢？若沒有人宣講，又怎能聽見呢？

教會邀請我們每一個人回應傳教的召叫。我們可以主動接觸鄰居、家人和朋友，也可以善用網路及各種媒體。

今天是聖博弟主教的慶日。聖博弟邀請我們信賴天主，並提醒我們耶穌所說的話：「莊稼多，工人少，所以你們應當求莊稼的主人派遣工人來收割他的莊稼。」聖博弟幫助當時的愛爾蘭人走近真光，帶領他們走出黑暗。他幫助他們明白，人的真正價值不在於戰爭、權力、社會地位或族裔之別。他想告訴我們，真正重要的是認識那位拯救我們的主基督。唯有在耶穌內，我們才能找到真正的力量、地位與永恆的平安。

願聖母幫助我們活出基督宗教的真精神，也願聖博弟為我們祈禱。

Christianity（基督宗教），英式發音：ˌkrɪstiˈænəti

en.title: What Is the Meaning of Life?
en.content:
What is the meaning of life? When we are depressed and our friends and family are away from us, we don't want to do anything and we start to wonder what we are living for. I was living for my family, for my friends, for myself, but now I don't want to do anything else. What is it that people live for?

thankfully, we know who we live for; we know who created us; we know that the life we live now is nothing compared to the Eternal Life; when we are in pain, when we are hurt by friends and family, when we are stuck in a problem that we have no way of resolving, We are sure that we have someone else to depend on.

Jesus, the irreplaceable name.For of all the names in the world given to men, this is the only one by which we can be saved.’Thank God that he has chosen us to be his sons and daughters. But who can know that Jesus is always helping us if we don't tell or live out the good news as well.

As St Paul says:they will not ask his help unless they believe in him, and they will not believe in him unless they have heard of him, and they will not hear of him unless they get a preacher.

The Church invites each of us to have a missionary vocation. To reach out to our neighbours, family, friends or use the internet, the media and so on.

Today is the solemnity of St Partrick: St Partrick invites us to trust in God and reminds us of the words of Jesus: The harvest is rich but the labourers are few, so ask the Lord of the harvest to send labourers to his harvest. St. Patrick helped the Irish at that time to approach the true light in order to pull them out of the darkness. He helped them to understand what is the true value of our humanity. It is not in war, it is not in power, it is not in social status or different races. He wants to tell us that it is only to know Christ, the Lord, who saves us. For power, position, and eternal peace are only to be found in Jesus.

May Our Lady help us to live out the true spirit of Christianity, and may St. partrick pray for us

Christianity英/ ˌkrɪstiˈænəti
